name: Lens Image Field
description: A cursor hover effect for React: an endless grid of images drifts behind your content, hidden except around a lens that trails the pointer, where pictures bloom larger the closer they are. Orbits by itself on touch. Canvas 2D, no dependencies.

props.name: images
props.description: Image URLs, any aspect ratio. They repeat across the endless grid; 20+ looks best.

props.name: size
props.description: Grid cell size, as a share of the box height.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between cells, as a share of the box height.

props.name: reach
props.description: Lens radius, as a share of the box height. Images outside it are hidden.

props.name: magnify
props.description: How large the image right under the lens gets.

props.name: speed
props.description: Drift speed of the grid in px per second (up and to the right). 0 holds it still.

props.name: follow
props.description: How quickly the lens catches up with the pointer.

props.name: children
props.description: Content under the field (the images draw over it). Anything marked data-lens-hide, like a button, clears the images while hovered.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. It fills its parent, so give the parent a height.
